name: India–Pakistan
value: Indus treaty in abeyance; no LoC strike found
summary: India keeps the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance; troops fired at suspected infiltration near the LoC on 16 Nov
state: Indian troops fired about two dozen rounds at unusual movement near the Line of Control in Poonch's Sawjian sector early on 16 Nov and began a search; no casualties or exchange with Pakistani forces were reported (Indian Defence News). India continues to hold the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance. No cross-border strike or mobilisation was found as of 19 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Jammu and Kashmir and areas near the India–Pakistan border.
rubric_hit: Treaty suspension in force and LoC firing = Watch; no cross-border strikes

sources.title: Indian Defence News — Army opens fire after suspected infiltration movement along LoC in Poonch

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.

rubric.watch: Ceasefire violations, a major terrorist attack with blame assigned, or treaty suspensions.
rubric.normal: Ceasefire holding along the Line of Control; no major attacks.
